title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Genesis 24: Abraham's servant finds a wife for Isaac, and Rebekah goes with him to Canaan.

questions.text: What did Abraham ask his servant to do before swearing an oath?
questions.explanation: Abraham said to his servant, "Please put your hand under my thigh," and made him swear by Yahweh.

answers.text: Put his hand under Abraham's thigh
Put his hand on Abraham's head
Lay his hand on the altar
Stand under the oaks of Mamre

questions.text: How many of his master's camels did the servant take?
questions.explanation: The servant took ten of his master's camels and departed, with good things of his master's with him.

questions.text: To which city in Mesopotamia did the servant go?
questions.explanation: He arose and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

questions.text: What sign did the servant ask Yahweh for at the spring?
questions.explanation: He prayed that the young lady who said, "Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink," would be the one appointed for Isaac.

answers.text: That she would offer him bread
That she would ask his name
That she would invite him home first
That she would offer to water his camels too

questions.explanation: Rebekah said, "I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor."

questions.text: What was the name of Rebekah's brother?
questions.explanation: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

questions.text: What did the servant say when food was set before him?
questions.explanation: He said, "I will not eat until I have told my message." Laban said, "Speak on."

answers.text: That he would not eat until he had told his message
That he would not eat until morning
That he would not eat until the camels were fed
That he would not eat until he met her father

questions.text: How long did Rebekah's brother and mother want her to stay before leaving?
questions.explanation: Her brother and her mother said, "Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go."

answers.text: A few days, at least ten

questions.text: What was Rebekah's answer when asked, "Will you go with this man?"
questions.explanation: They called Rebekah and asked her, "Will you go with this man?" She said, "I will go."

questions.text: Where did Isaac bring Rebekah, after which he was comforted after his mother's death?
questions.explanation: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and she became his wife. He loved her, and he was comforted after his mother's death.

answers.text: To the well of Beer Lahai Roi
